crossRefs.note: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped…

translations.web: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
translations.bsb: Saul and the men of Israel assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah, arraying themselves for battle against the Philistines.
translations.kjv: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
translations.asv: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the vale of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
